quantity_rules.justification: 42 m3/day is printed to the nearest whole m3/day; half the displayed unit is 0.5 m3/day
99.6% is printed to one decimal place; half the displayed unit is 0.05 percentage point
28.4 m3/day is printed to one decimal place; half the displayed unit is 0.05 m3/day
99.8% is printed to one decimal place; half the displayed unit is 0.05 percentage point

registry.combined_tolerance_rule: For each Layer B quantity, PASS if absolute error <= absolute tolerance OR relative error <= relative tolerance (max(abs, rel) envelope); every quantity must pass
registry.typical_vs_minimum: Keep manufacturer envelope acceptance separate from numerical regression; do not convert either into solver tolerance
registry.rounding_rule: Compare at full precision before display rounding; tolerances are half the manufacturer sheet displayed least-significant unit

next_gate: Obtain board approval in the detached approval record, then notify/reopen TOT-67 for same-candidate-SHA rerun
